title: AcademicEvaluationCaseContract
description: Contract schema for permanent evaluation test cases and benchmark scenarios used to test improvement candidates.

case_id.description: Unique identifier for this evaluation test case (e.g. EVAL-CASE-REG-001).

capability.description: Target capability tested by this case (e.g. sem, regression, apa_reporting, data_cleaning).

required_metrics.description: Deterministic cutoffs or expected parameters (e.g. df, R2 bounds, fit index thresholds).

required_reasoning_properties.description: Methodological and theoretical properties the candidate must explicitly evaluate (e.g. repeated-measures structure, missingness, imbalance, covariance structure, estimand, candidate model comparison).

forbidden_behaviors.description: Behaviors that automatically trigger failure (e.g. p = .000, missing leading zeros, Baron & Kenny mediation, mental math).

difficulty.description: Graduated difficulty level (e.g. L1_UNIVARIATE_BASELINE, L2_INTERDEPENDENT_MODELS, L3_LATENT_STRUCTURAL_SYSTEMS, L4_ADVERSARIAL_EDGE_CASES, easy, medium, hard).

tags.description: Topical and methodological tags for fast test suite indexing.

originating_lesson_id.description: Identifier of originating lesson distilled from failure or feedback.

originating_experience_id.description: Identifier of originating raw experience record.

originating_feedback_id.description: Identifier of originating user feedback contract.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the evaluation test case.

expected_behavior.description: Scholarly description of expected reasoning and empirical behavior.

forbidden_behavior.description: Description of anti-pattern or forbidden behavior triggering failure.

validation_evidence.description: Structured audit records confirming the case was validated before becoming a permanent regression asset.

retirement_reason.description: Formal justification required if a regression case is explicitly retired.

repeat_count.description: Cumulative count of times this failure or mistake has recurred.

last_seen_at.description: Timestamp when this failure pattern was most recently observed.
